page: Amazon Web Services m7g.2xlarge is a general-purpose server powered by the AWS Graviton processor family. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs based on the 64-bit ARMv8 architecture, specifically utilizing the Neoverse-V1 model running at 2.6 GHz. The CPU configuration includes 64 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache per processor. It lacks hyperthreading, allocating one thread per physical core. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on the Nitro hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the m7g.2xlarge mostly in the average performance tier. Its stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU performance scores are 1532.49 and 12247.03 respectively, both falling within the middle 50% of tested servers. The server displays strong memory performance, with a PassMark memory score of 2868.55, placing it in the top 25% of its class. Memory bandwidth tests show 773.36 GB/sec for cached small blocks, 147.52 GB/sec for uncached large block reads, and 70.28 GB/sec for large block writes. However, its PassMark CPU score of 6070.64 and encryption test score of 1115.06 are positioned in the bottom 25%. For language model tasks, it processes 135M model prompts at 480.8 tokens per second, but performance drops to 14.12 tokens per second for 7B model prompt processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64-based architecture provides a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU without the overhead of hyperthreading. This makes the instance efficient for workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores and strong memory bandwidth. The server is appropriate for general-purpose workloads, including static web serving (demonstrating 15.41 GB/sec throughput), database operations (averaging 8044.59 PassMark database operations and 13.12 million Redis SET operations per second), software compilation, and light text or image processing.
